summary: At commit b9bc766, Round 2 does make real progress: α is demoted back toward scaffolding, β now explicitly records the missing adversarial effective-channel reduction as β.G5, and γ v0.4 removes the v0.3 super-receiver merge entirely. But the round does not fully close all Round 1 findings. α still leaves its gap inventory internally inconsistent, β still reintroduces non-agnostic tightness language after the opening fix notice, and γ Step B replaces the old fusion error with a new unproved cross-model transfer from an Alice-Charlie point-to-point capacity to the Alice-Bob umr key task. The critical v0.2/v0.3 patterns are not literally repeated, so this is not REJECTED, but the package remains FAIL.

issues.description: Path α verdict: FAIL. The document does accept the Round 1 demotion in substance, restores the missing L3 rate-alignment gap, and explicitly says the identity-embedding move is the same class of trap as v0.2. However, the promised restoration of the original 11-gap scaffolding is not carried through cleanly in-file: §3 collapses to a 5-row high-level summary, while §5 still says '6 gaps explicit'. That leaves the Round 1 closure only partial, because the reader is still given mixed signals about whether α is purely scaffolding or a reduced-gap derivation record.
issues.suggestion: Make α unambiguously scaffolding-only. Either reproduce the full 11-gap inventory from `umr_path_alpha_scaffolding.md` in this file, or state that the linked scaffolding document is the sole authoritative 11-gap list; then delete leftover '6 gaps explicit' language and any active text that still contrasts the identity-embedding move with v0.2 beyond saying it is the same-class hazard.

issues.description: Path β verdict: FAIL. β.G5 is now present, so the missing adversarial-channel/adaptive-comb reduction gap from Round 1 is explicitly flagged. But the tightness fix is not fully closed. The header and comparison table are agnostic, while §2.3 and §2.5 revert to treating `f(η_A,η_B) < -log2(1-√(η_Aη_B))` as the expected Log 07 direction. That still overreads the present evidence, because the effective-channel REE could end up smaller, comparable, or larger. The closing rigor note also still says '4 gaps explicit' after adding β.G5.
issues.suggestion: Keep β.G5, but neutralize the residual '<' language in §2.3/§2.5 so the whole document stays agnostic about relative tightness until an actual comparison lemma or SDP result is in hand. Also update the closing rigor summary to 5 gaps.

issues.description: Path γ verdict: FAIL. The Round 1 v0.3 issue is closed in the narrow sense: the Bob+Charlie+Eve super-receiver merge is gone, and Step A's isolated Alice→Charlie PLOB application is acceptable as a standalone point-to-point statement with Charlie as the holder of the output system. The new problem is Step B. Log 07 §4.5 only motivates a data-processing/correlation monotonicity step, but v0.4 upgrades that into the stronger cross-task claim `K_AB(Π) ≤ K_AC^{LOPC}(E1)` between different party sets and security models. It also describes Charlie's joint BSM with Bob's mode as merely 'classical downstream processing', even though Bob's mode enters a joint quantum operation before the classical announcement. So the hidden fusion is removed, but the proof still lacks a justified transfer from an Alice-Charlie capacity bound to the Alice-Bob umr key-rate setting.
issues.suggestion: Keep Step A, but rewrite Step B to match Log 07 §4.5 exactly: state only a target DPI/LOCC-monotonicity lemma about Alice-Bob correlation or key rate under downstream operations on Charlie's received mode, without identifying it with an Alice-Charlie secret-key-capacity comparison until a formal multi-party-to-point-to-point reduction is proved.

round_recommendation: Round 3 should make α a clean scaffolding document with one authoritative 11-gap inventory, keep β.G5 but remove the remaining non-agnostic tightness language, and narrow γ Step B to the precise Log 07 DPI target rather than an unproved `K_AB ≤ K_AC` capacity transfer. None of the three paths is ready to upgrade beyond [CONJ] yet.
